answer_1.quote: We prompt GPT-4 to generate appeals based on the description of appeals and the CTRL as a basis.
answer_1.outputs: persuasive appeal passages (logical, credibility, emotional) supporting misinformation

answer_2.quote: We introduce two tasks. (1) Textual entailment (NLI) evaluates if the generated appeal supports the corresponding CTRL. (2) Strategy alignment checks if the generated message applies the corresponding persuasive strategy. We conduct these two tasks using GPT-4.

answer_3.quote: We conduct these two tasks using GPT-4 to evaluate whether the generated appeals are entailed by the CTRL and whether they follow the intended persuasive strategy.

answer_4.quote: We engage five annotators for a formal validation. We report the overall percentage agreement, Fleiss's Kappa (κ), and Percentage of Positive Cases of the three validation tasks.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to answer yes/no for (1) MCQ option quality, (2) semantic alignment of CTRL statements, and (3) whether appeal passages applied the specified persuasive strategy.
